title: Redesign Create a loop
question: Three ways to give the map the screen while you build, all in Pasyar's own colours and type. Every one has the tap-a-point action row (MAKE MAIN STOP · REMOVE), big live km and time, 'Club' instead of 'Group', and a collapsed caption. Pick the one to build.

options.label: Map + point strip
options.thesis: Build on a near-full map; your points ride along the bottom as a strip of numbered chips, and the form only comes up after DONE.
options.viewport: Map fills ~70%; a short bottom panel shows 96 KM · 3 H 10 at stat size, a scrolling strip S · 1 · 2 · 3⚑ · +, and DONE. Tapping a point (on the map or strip) shows MAKE MAIN STOP · REMOVE.
options.risk: Two steps instead of one sheet: riders who want to name the loop first must tap DONE before they can.

options.label: Route | Details tabs
options.thesis: One sheet, two tabs: Route shows live stats and the point list with actions; Details holds name, caption and who can see it.
options.viewport: Map top ~55%; sheet with a Route | Details switch; Route lists S, 1, 2, 3 as rows with the main-stop flag and a REMOVE action; SAVE and SHARE LINK stay pinned at the bottom.
options.risk: Keeps a tall sheet over the map; the map gains less room than the other two.

options.label: Peek sheet
options.thesis: Same single sheet as today, but it starts lowered to a peek bar with live stats and DONE; drag or tap DONE to bring up the form.
options.viewport: Map fills nearly the whole screen; a 112 px peek bar at the bottom reads 96 KM · 3 H 10 · 3 points with DONE; the action row floats by a tapped point.
options.risk: Least change: dragging a sheet is a hidden gesture, so DONE has to carry the discoverability.
